caption:
Patience and prayer: your two supports for this Sunday morning.

Allah tells us to seek help through patience and prayer, and that this is hard except for the humble. Start the day by turning to Him before turning to anything else.

Surah Al-Baqara 2:45

Before you reach for your phone again, pause for one short du'a.

#quran #patienceandprayer #salah #morningreminder
alt_text: Seek help through patience and prayer. It is strenuous except for the humble (Surah Al-Baqara 2:45)
